# Cardfile
> A modern digital card file for your notes. Native, fast and private: written in Rust with GPUI. Windows and Linux.

Cardfile 2 is a full rewrite (currently in beta) of the Cardfile notes app. Notes live on cards edited in a WYSIWYG editor (users never see Markdown), stored in a local SQLite database. No telemetry.

## Key Resources
- [Website](https://cardfile.fitty.ar): Landing page and screenshots.
- [Changelog](https://cardfile.fitty.ar/changelog.html): Release history.

## Features
- Word-like editor: headings, lists, checklists, tables, code blocks, colors, images, attachments, inline audio.
- Full-text search (SQLite FTS5), tags, favorites, pinned cards, manual ordering, version history, recycle bin.
- Card protection: read-only, private (password to view) and encrypted (XChaCha20-Poly1305, Argon2id), per-user keys, card sharing.
- Multi-user, single-password or password-free mode.
- Export to Markdown, HTML, PDF and JSON; portable mode.
- Optional AI assistant (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, Ollama, LM Studio and more), hidden until configured.
- Built-in MCP server on 127.0.0.1 with per-client API keys for AI apps such as Claude, Cursor or VS Code.
- 21 interface languages, CJK and right-to-left scripts, 15 themes, command palette, configurable shortcuts.
- Self-updater that verifies SHA-256 and minisign signatures.

## Quick Installation

### Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FittyAr/Cardfile/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

### Linux
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FittyAr/Cardfile/main/install.sh | sh
```
